title: Embedding precision profiles (INT8/FP16) calibration runbook & cosine drift gating
creator: Marco Jensen
description: Goal: Produce an operational runbook and automated validation pipeline for shipping INT8 and FP16 embedding profiles with clear acceptance gates based on cosine-similarity / retrieval metrics. This ticket covers: (1) empirical calibration procedures for INT8 and FP16 profiles, (2) a suite of automated checks to detect cosine-similarity drift vs a floating-point baseline, (3) rollout gating rules (canary/rollback) and alert thresholds, and (4) integration points for the Console telemetry and CI benchmarks. Success criteria: 1) INT8 profiles that meet per-dataset cosine mean drop <= 0.005 and retrieval MRR degradation <= 1.5% vs FP32 baseline for >= 90% of calibration datasets, 2) automated daily drift detection on production traffic with actionable alerts, 3) documented rollback playbook and canary config applied to Dedicated/Hosted deployments.
calibration_plan: Dataset selection: curated mixture of 10 datasets (semantic search corpora, paraphrase pairs, classification queries) covering short/long queries and domain shift
Metrics: mean cosine similarity, 5th percentile cosine, fraction below cosine threshold, retrieval MRR@10, nearest-neighbor label-accuracy, cluster-preservation score (Silhouette approximations)

Methods to run: MinMax per-tensor, per-channel symmetric INT8, per-channel asymmetric INT8, group-wise 4/8bit subquantization experiments, FP16 mixed-precision baseline with and without stochastic rounding
Calibration algorithms: KL-divergence histogram fit, MSE minimization, percentile clipping (e.g., 99.9%) with ADJUSTED zero-point, EMA-based activation range estimation for activations
Handling outliers: detect heavy-tailed activation distributions and use per-channel clipping + outlier exclusion (mask out top 0.1% activations during scale computation)
Weight vs activation quant ordering: evaluate weight-only INT8 then weight+activation INT8 to isolate sources of drift
Batching for calibration runs: run on representative batch sizes (1, 8, 64) to capture dynamic range for KV cache sizes
Produce profile artifact: JSON profile with layer-scale tables, per-layer clipping %, calibration seed, and dataset hash for reproducibility
validation_suite: Baseline: FP32 embeddings computed across calibration datasets and stored as reference vectors (with versioned artifact ids)
Primary pass: compute embeddings with candidate profile, compute pairwise cosines vs baseline and aggregate metrics
Delta metrics used for gating: median_cosine_delta, p5_cosine_delta, fraction_below_cosine_threshold (default threshold=0.985), retrieval_MRR_ratio
Statistical tests: paired bootstrap for MRR and Wilcoxon signed-rank for cosine shifts to detect non-zero median drift
Accept criteria: median_cosine_delta >= -0.005 AND fraction_below_cosine_threshold <= 0.07 AND retrieval_MRR_ratio >= 0.985
Regression recording: store per-dataset diffs + sample examples where similarity drop > 0.03 for human triage
Cross-check: downstream probe tasks (semantic-similarity classifier AUC and KNN label accuracy) to catch pathological cases where cosine mask hides retrieval loss
rollout_gates: Canary config: 5% traffic to INT8 profile in hosted region + dedicated canary pool for 24 hours
Automated checks during canary: run validation_suite against production-sampled reference minibatches every hour
Alert triggers: any hourly median_cosine_delta < -0.01 OR retrieval_MRR_ratio < 0.98 OR p5_cosine_delta < -0.03 => auto-rollback
Manual gates: product/ML lead sign-off required if fraction_below_cosine_threshold > 0.05 even if other metrics pass
Fallback policy: automatic reroute to FP16 baseline model variant with preserved API contract and KV cache compatibility
monitoring_and_drift_policy: Daily snapshot: compute median_cosine_over_last_24h vs baseline_ref and report change
Monthly baseline refresh: re-run FP32 baseline on rolling production sample to update reference vectors (store as versioned artifact)
Drift alerting: page on median drop > 0.02 OR increase in fraction_below_cosine_threshold by > 5 percentage points
Investigation playbook: on alert, run targeted calibration (fast re-calibration) and sample 200 worst-case queries for human review
Automatic mitigation: if drift persists > 48h, shift traffic back to FP16 baseline and create postmortem ticket
observability_integration: Console dashboards: per-model profile view showing layer-scale heatmap, median_cosine_delta over time, MRR trends, and canary cohort breakdown
Logging: embed vector computation latency, quantization profile id, calibration dataset hash, and RNG seed for each embedding invocation metadata
Telemetry retention: store daily aggregated diffs for 90 days and raw sample diffs for 30 days
CI integration: add a nightly job in inference-ci that runs the validation_suite across small synthetic corpora with assertions mapped to PR blocking rules
experiments: E1: INT8 symmetric per-channel vs per-tensor comparison on two models and 4 datasets to quantify layer sensitivity
E2: FP16 with reduced mantissa (simulated) to test low-precision rounding effects on clustering
E3: INT8 with percentile clipping tuned per-layer vs global clipping to evaluate simplicity vs accuracy trade-offs
E4: Quantization-aware finetuning (QAT) limited experiment on one small model to see if fine-tuning recovers >50% of lost MRR (if any)
